rationale: The brief must draw on the portfolio description, the fraud exploration, both modelling tasks and at least one provider or denial analysis, but the request does not map those roles to task ids, so all seven earlier tasks (T1-T7) are collected; collect_findings records any missing source rather than inventing a value, so the full set maximises coverage with no traceability risk. The brief carries exactly the five required sections (key findings, model results, limitations, synthetic-data caveats, next steps); methodology is omitted to keep a non-technical one-pager under 600 words. causal_language=avoid enforces association-only phrasing and cite_artifacts=true attaches a [source: path] to every numeric statement, both explicit task requirements. report.md prints every rate as numerator/denominator, cites every results bullet, and carries the synthetic-data and no-operational-use caveats required by the task plus association-not-causation and model-limitations for the modelling summaries; class_imbalance is included because the fraud label is roughly 5% prevalent (fraud_pattern_type is null on 12198 of 12845 claims) and small_groups because provider-level findings rest on only 150 providers.
